answer: Bonded identities place collateral in escrow, and equivocation proofs link their signed actions. For k coordinated identities, correlated penalties scale as O(k^2), reflecting pairwise conflicts; detection also triggers an exponential multiplier on capital loss, so splitting stake among sybils cannot dilute risk. Asymmetric depreciation limits recovery of seized value: a node cannot wander across a bridge or hide in a dune to escape attribution.
